definition: In this source, “not otherwise specified” refers to psychotic disorder not otherwise specified, a diagnosis used for some patients with psychotic disorders who are considered outside the bipolar disorder and schizophrenia spectrum categories being compared. The source also indicates that the clinical presentations included under this diagnosis are not yet well understood.

reasons: The packet supports the specific diagnosis “psychotic disorder not otherwise specified (PNOS),” but not the standalone term “not otherwise specified” as that diagnosis.

The claim that the diagnosis is used for patients “considered outside the bipolar disorder and schizophrenia spectrum categories being compared” is not stated in the packet and overinterprets the comparison groups.

The statement that the clinical presentations under this diagnosis are “not yet well understood” is broadly supported by the packet’s “lack of knowledge” wording, but the definition adds unsupported specificity beyond the source text.

The packet does not state that PNOS is used to label patients “considered outside the bipolar disorder and schizophrenia spectrum categories.” It only says PNOS is compared to bipolar disorder and schizophrenia spectrum diagnoses.
The definition’s framing about being “outside” those categories is an unsupported inference beyond the provided text.
